card.name: Temperature words and degree units
card.fires_on: The word temperature, or the digits and unit (C, Celsius, °F) in a temperature figure, in cooking, storage, sterilizing or climate text. Also fires partway through the drug name dapagliflozin.

modes.label: Temperature wording
modes.description: The word temperature or temperatures right after a modifier like operating or room.
modes.example: SYMLIN should be at room<< temperature>> before injecting to reduce potential injection site reactions

modes.label: Degree figures
modes.description: A digit or unit inside a stated temperature value.
modes.example: keep global average temperature from increases below 2 degrees<< Celsius>>.

modes.label: Dapagliflozin name
modes.description: The middle of the drug name dapagliflozin.
modes.example: The concomitant use of dapaglif<<lo>>zin and metformin hydrochloride

card.writes: It suppresses the word temperature and related terms, so it likely steers the model away from repeating them once a temperature is already stated.
card.plain: It lights up on temperature phrases and degree values, such as room temperature or 121°C, and on part of the drug name dapagliflozin.
